title: Dropbox synced folder
whyItMatters: Dropbox keeps a local copy of synced files. Those copies can contain private documents even after the account is signed out.
source: Dropbox on File Provider moves the folder to ~/Library/CloudStorage/Dropbox - https://www.macforensics.app/en/artifacts/cloud-storage-clients
notes: Newer File Provider installs only. Legacy ~/Dropbox may be a symlink to this folder; the path jail never follows links. Online-only placeholders are not hydrated.

cleanup.exportFirst: Copy any file you need that exists only in the local Dropbox folder to a drive you keep, since the copies go with it.
cleanup.signOut: In the Dropbox menu bar icon open the account settings and sign out, then remove this Mac from the account's connected devices.
steps: Quit Dropbox from the menu bar icon so the folder is not in use.
Delete the Dropbox folder named in the plan, then empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Local copies on this Mac are removed. Files still in the Dropbox account are untouched, and online-only files were never here.
cleanup.source: Dropbox Help, Sign in and sign out of Dropbox: https://help.dropbox.com/account-access/sign-in-out
